findings.message: `tabIndex` should only be declared on interactive elements.
Non-interactive elements should not be assigned interactive roles.
No access key attribute allowed. Inconsistencies between keyboard shortcuts and keyboard commands used by screen readers and keyboard-only users create a11y complications.
The element ol has an implicit role of list. Defining this explicitly is redundant and should be avoided.
`tabIndex` should only be declared on interactive elements.
A form label must be associated with a control.
